signature: SUBROUTINE DLASR( SIDE, PIVOT, DIRECT, M, N, C, S, A, LDA )

params.name: side
params.reference:
Specifies whether the plane rotation matrix P is applied to A on the left or the right.

-   `= 'L'`: Left, compute A := $P \, A$
-   `= 'R'`: Right, compute A:= $A \, P^T$

params.name: pivot
params.reference:
Specifies the plane for which P(k) is a plane rotation matrix.

-   `= 'V'`: Variable pivot, the plane (k,k+1)
-   `= 'T'`: Top pivot, the plane (1,k+1)
-   `= 'B'`: Bottom pivot, the plane (k,z)

params.name: direct
params.reference:
Specifies whether P is a forward or backward sequence of plane rotations.

-   `= 'F'`: Forward, $P = P(z-1)$\*...\*$P(2) \, P(1)$
-   `= 'B'`: Backward, $P = P(1) \, P(2)$\*...\*P(z-1)

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. If $m \le 1$, an immediate return is effected.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. If $n \le 1$, an immediate return is effected.

params.name: c
params.reference: (N-1) if `SIDE = 'R'` The cosines c(k) of the plane rotations.

params.name: s
params.reference: (N-1) if `SIDE = 'R'` The sines s(k) of the plane rotations. The 2-by-2 plane rotation part of the matrix P(k), R(k), has the form $R(k) = ( c(k) s(k) )$ ( -s(k) c(k) ).

params.name: A
params.reference: The M-by-N matrix A. On exit, A is overwritten by $P \, A$ if `SIDE = 'L'` or by $A \, P^T$ if `SIDE = 'R'`.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

checks.fortran: .NOT.( LSAME( PIVOT, 'V' ) .OR. LSAME( PIVOT, 'T' ) .OR. LSAME( PIVOT, 'B' ) )
